events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The drawer's parts, usually a header, a body and a footer; any element is allowed.
props.name: children

props.description:
The element that opens the drawer when pressed: a Button, or any pressable element. Leave it out for a drawer the
app opens through `isOpen`. Focus returns to the element that opened the drawer when it closes.
props.name: trigger

props.description:
The heights a bottom drawer rests at, smallest first; it opens at the first. On native a drag moves between them
and a drag down past the first dismisses; on web a press on the handle moves to the next.
props.name: snapPoints

props.description:
The width of a side drawer: `sm` 400, `md` 560 (the default), `lg` 720 or `full`, always capped to the screen less
the insets. A top or bottom drawer is the full width.
props.name: size

props.description:
True, the default, to float the drawer clear of the screen's edges with rounded corners; false to sit it flush
against its edge.
props.name: inset

props.description: The accessible name for a drawer that has no `Drawer.Title`; with a title, the title names it.
props.name: label

props.description:
True, the default, to close the overlay on a press outside it (the backdrop on a modal, a drawer and a dialog).
Set false for a step the user must finish, and give the content its own close control.
props.name: isDismissable

props.description:
True to keep the Escape key from closing the overlay. It is for a flow with unsaved work or a nested overlay
open, so set it only with `isDismissable` false or a close control in reach. Native has no Escape key, so it
stays unread there unless a component's own page says it maps to the Android back button.
props.name: isKeyboardDismissDisabled

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Animation configuration
props.name: animation

props.description: Additional CSS class for the background
props.name: backgroundClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the bottom sheet
props.name: className

props.description: Additional CSS class for the container
props.name: containerClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the content container
props.name: contentContainerClassName

props.description: Props for the content container
props.name: contentContainerProps

props.description: Additional CSS class for the handle
props.name: handleClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the handle indicator
props.name: handleIndicatorClassName

props.description:
View style to be applied to the sheet container component,
it also could be an Animated Style.
props.name: style

events.description: Called instead of the default (pop the view, or close this layer).
events.name: onPress

props.description: The accessible name; defaults to "Back" in the app's language.
props.name: label

props.description: The title's text; it is also the overlay's accessible name.
props.name: children

props.description:
The title's level in the outline, 1 to 6. Defaults to 2: the page keeps its own `h1`, and the overlay's title is a
section of it. React Native has no heading level, so native accepts and ignores it.
props.name: level

props.description: Additional CSS class for the title
props.name: className

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID

events.description: Called when the button is pressed, by pointer, touch or keyboard.
events.name: onPress

props.description: The accessible name in the app's language, for example "Close" or "Dismiss notification".
props.name: label

props.description: An icon in place of HeroUI's close mark: an icon name or any icon element.
props.name: icon

props.description: True to refuse presses and show the disabled style.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: Web parity: native always draws the close mark (a phone has no Escape key); `"none"` draws nothing.
props.name: closeButton

props.description: Animation configuration for scale and highlight feedback
props.name: animation

props.description:
When `true`, merges press behavior and animated scale onto the single child (Slot pattern).
The child must be one React element. Uses `Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Slot.Pressable)` internally.
props.name: asChild

props.description:
Background layer rendered behind the button surface.
- `undefined` (default): renders `Button.Background` for the `secondary`
  and `tertiary` variants when the active library theme registers
  default background content (e.g. `glass`); otherwise no layer
- custom node: replaces the default layer entirely
- `null`: removes the background layer
props.name: background

props.description: Additional CSS classes
props.name: className

props.description: Feedback variant that renders Scale + Highlight compound parts
props.name: feedbackVariant

props.description: Props for customizing the close icon
props.name: iconProps

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description:
Whether the root's built-in animated styles (react-native-reanimated) are active.
When `false`, the animated scale style is not applied and you can implement custom logic.
props.name: isAnimatedStyleActive

props.description: Whether the button displays an icon only (needed for correct layout)
props.name: isIconOnly

props.description: Size of the button
props.name: size

props.description:
Either view styles or a function that receives a boolean reflecting whether
the component is currently pressed and returns view styles.
props.name: style

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID

props.description: Visual variant of the button
props.name: variant
